recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. The original scope/usage rewrite and v2-reference removal are preserved, while the remaining stale search-parameter wording now matches the current conformance source.
issue_request: FHIR-5301 was a Published Patient Administration DSTU1 technical correction for Schedule. The ballot comment asked that incomplete Schedule scope/usage text be replaced with guidance on finding schedules for HealthcareService categories or practitioner/location actors, and the final Persuasive with Modification resolution required removing HL7 v2 references and reworking the scope and usage section with more accurate information.
initial_application: Commit be470cb21da4107826991acb4bd95704746d88a2 historically applied the Schedule narrative rewrite by removing the unfinished placeholder and HL7 v2/RIM discussion and adding actor/searching guidance. A later 2017 Schedule QA commit preserved the guidance but changed the old type-property sentence into a generic type-parameter sentence.
additional_context: Schedule is active in source/fhir.ini, and current Schedule source no longer contains the v2 references FHIR-5301 targeted. Later Published issue FHIR-22687 changed Schedule.serviceType to CodeableReference(HealthcareService) and split the search surface into service-type and service-type-reference; the active introduction still referred to a non-existent generic type parameter.
reconciliation: Changed source/schedule/schedule-introduction.xml to reference the current service-type and service-type-reference search parameters in the checking-availability guidance.
source_changes: source/schedule/schedule-introduction.xml: replaced stale generic "type parameter" wording with current "service-type" and "service-type-reference" search parameter names.

related_jiras.note: Changed Schedule.serviceType to CodeableReference(HealthcareService) and introduced service-type-reference, which determined the current search parameter names used in this reconciliation.
